title: China showcases humanoid robots, high-tech ambitions at global summit in Shenzhen

ai.summary: China showcased humanoid robots at a global summit in Shenzhen to demonstrate technological advancements and AI leadership, with robots performing dances and serving refreshments for delegates.

facts.claim: China showcased humanoid robots at a global summit in Shenzhen
facts.quote: New Delhi, Nov 18: Alongside high-level diplomatic engagements with world leaders, China is using the international summit in Shenzhen to showcase its growing technological capabilities, with humanoid robots emerging as a major attraction at the event.

facts.claim: Humanoid robots performed coordinated dances, welcoming visiting delegates and serving refreshments
facts.quote: Humanoid robots have been performing coordinated dances, welcoming visiting delegates and serving refreshments at various venues, offering a glimpse of China’s advances in artificial intelligence and robotics.

facts.claim: The display aims to demonstrate Beijing’s growing leadership in physical AI and ambition to dominate the global robotics market
facts.quote: The display goes beyond providing entertainment to visiting dignitaries. It is also aimed at demonstrating Beijing’s growing leadership in physical artificial intelligence (AI) and its ambition to become a dominant force in the global robotics market.

facts.claim: Shenzhen, a major technology and manufacturing hub, provides a fitting setting for the showcase
facts.quote: Shenzhen, a major technology and manufacturing hub, provides a fitting setting for the showcase.
